entries.en: I can see Yusuke in the distance.[n]He seems to be viewing a painting...
I don't see my friends here...[n]I should go elsewhere...

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I just got a call from Kitagawa-kun.[n]He said he's found a new theme[n]he wishes to paint.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Yes, he didn't give me the details, but[n]I was able to pick up the gist of it—[n]something about friendship.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: Yes, he didn't give me the details, but[n]I was able to pick up the gist of it—[n]something about friendship.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: *chuckle* I'm so excited, I can hardly[n]contain it. Rather unbecoming of[n]a person my age, I know, but still.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I'm sure you understand, though.[n]Whatever it is he comes up with,[n]it's sure to be a masterpiece.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I very much look forward to the day[n]I can see it.
I should say goodbye[n]to Kawanabe, then go[n]elsewhere...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You already talked to Kawanabe.[n]Let's go somewhere else.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: He's able to make such progress as an[n]artist because he has someone like you,[n]who understands him.

entries.speaker: Kawanabe
entries.en: I can't wait to see his next work...[n]It's sure to be awe-inspiring.
